question: do these windows carry more JASPAR motif hits than dinucleotide-preserving scrambles of themselves?
outcome_kind: computed motif hit counts; NOT observed binding, NOT functional evidence, NOT a claim about any live fish
primary_endpoint: total hits across all motifs, real vs own mean shuffle, paired across windows (ONE test)
pseudocounts: JASPAR sqrt(N)/4 via Bio.motifs.jaspar.calculate_pseudocounts; without them only 6 of 879 motifs yield a finite threshold

background.kind: single pooled background over all real held-out windows
background.why: threshold_fpr costs ~244 s for 879 motifs, so a per-sequence background was unaffordable; real and its shuffle share identical PSSMs and thresholds, so the paired contrast remains composition-controlled
background.forfeits: cross-sequence hit-count comparison is composition-confounded and descriptive only
